scenario_full_season_hb_low_nutrient_car.core_task: Low nutrient carryover, weak flowering-stage growth, and need-based nutritional management.
scenario_full_season_hb_low_nutrient_car.reason: With the official soybean nitrogen fixation fraction0.8 retained, controlled flowering-stage nitrogen applications changed final native grain yield by at most0.072%. RFRGRL is a juvenile exponential leaf-area growth factor, and its mapped nutrient_index cannot alone diagnose flowering-stage nitrogen deficiency.
scenario_full_season_hb_low_nutrient_car.user_decision: Do not add a nutrition or nitrogen-fixation limitation mechanism this round. Keep the original scenario file unchanged and mark it uncalibrated.
